name: Konno Fusa
source: [From [url=http://yorunohitsuji.xii.jp/products/lonely_yuri]Yoru no Hitsuji[/url]] Fusa is a diligent high school student. But, she thinks she is naive and wants to change that characteristic. One day her teacher asks her to bring some handouts to a classmate, Seri Aeba. That encounter changes... She often feels lonely, but pretends not.
